stylingNotes: Sans 'On this page' title (22px mobile / 24px desktop, weight 300) above a list of single-line links (18px/28px, 20px/32px desktop; ellipsis when too long), each with an orange south-east arrow that turns ochre with the text on hover; no rule; 8-of-12 column width on desktop.
variantRationale: Source cmp-toc is generated client-side from the page H2s; no library block covers it, so it is a new custom block (base 'toc').
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Auto-generated 'On this page' list of anchor links to the page H2s

contentPattern.summary: Authored empty (optionally one title row); links are built at runtime from main h2 elements so they never drift from the headings
contentPattern.structure: optional row 1 = title text (default 'On this page'); no other rows

rows: Optional title, e.g. On this page
blockContent.notes: Do not author the links; the block builds them from every H2 in main and removes itself when there are none.

reuseGuidance: Use once per page, after the intro, on long text pages with H2 sections. Leave the block empty or give it a single title row; never type the links by hand.
usageDescription: Contents list for text pages that jumps to each H2 section.
